title: PoLAR: Factorizing Extent and Mode in Latent Actions for Robot Policy Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.21139v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robot actions vary in both extent and mode: how much change they produce and what kind of change they produce. A latent action space that reflects this structure may make it easier for downstream policies to map latent actions to robot actions. However, existing latent action methods typically rely on visual reconstruction from observation pairs without explicitly encouraging such structure. We introduce Polar Latent Actions with Radial structure (PoLAR), which imposes a radial-direction structure on latent actions, encouraging radius to encode transition extent and direction to retain transition mode. PoLAR uses temporal offsets between observations as a weak proxy for transition extent, encouraging transitions with larger offsets to occupy larger radii. We instantiate this structure in hyperbolic space, whose expanding volume with radius offers a natural fit for more diverse transition modes at larger extents. Across in-task

translated_title: PoLAR：在机器人策略学习的潜在动作中分解幅度与模式
translated_abstract: 机器人的动作在幅度和模式两个维度上各不相同：即它们产生多大的变化，以及产生何种类型的变化。一个能够反映这种结构的潜在动作空间，可以使下游策略更容易将潜在动作映射为机器人动作。然而，现有的潜在动作方法通常依赖于从观测对进行的视觉重建，而没有显式地鼓励这种结构。我们提出了具有径向结构的极坐标潜在动作，它在潜在动作上施加径向-方向结构，鼓励半径编码过渡的幅度，方向保留过渡的模式。PoLAR 使用观测之间的时间偏移作为过渡幅度的弱代理，鼓励具有较大时间偏移的过渡占据更大的半径。我们在双曲空间中实例化这一结构，双曲空间随半径增长而扩大的体积，天然适合在更大幅度下容纳更多样化的过渡模式。在任务内……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PoLAR 通过在潜在动作空间中引入极坐标径向结构（半径编码动作幅度、方向编码动作模式），并借助双曲空间与观测时间偏移作为约束，使机器人策略更容易将潜在动作解码为实际的机器人动作。
en_tdlr: PoLAR imposes a polar radial structure on latent actions—radius encodes transition extent while direction encodes transition mode—using hyperbolic space and temporal offsets between observations, making it easier for downstream policies to map latent actions to robot actions.
